policy: Every SIMBAD object with a compiled Johnson V <= 6.5, a positive parallax and an adopted distance within 20,000 light-years. Clusters, galaxies, supernovae and other non-stellar types are excluded, as are ** aggregates whose components are listed. Stars curated by the nearby or constellation catalogs, matched by exact identifier or within 20 arcsec at a consistent distance, keep that record and ID; their reviewed companions follow. A component without a parallax of its own uses the parallax and motion of its SIMBAD multiple-star record; other stars without a parallax are listed in the provenance audit, not placed. Sun is included only as the map origin.
physicalPolicy: New records use the shared exact-identity enrichment without Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot [M/H]. Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot and FLAME values are withheld for O, B0-B4 and M spectral types, FLAME values for parallax signal-to-noise below 10, and any temperature more than 35% from the Pecaut-Mamajek temperature of its spectral class is withheld before selection, with the values derived from the same solution: FLAME values, Allende Prieto & Lambert 1999 mass and radius, and McDonald et al. 2012 luminosity. These two Hipparcos model solutions are also withheld when their temperature lies more than 20% from an adopted spectroscopic temperature, and McDonald et al. 2012 fits are not used for O and B stars, whose zero-reddening fits run systematically cool. The more accurate temperature wins; FLAME values that assumed a different GSP-Phot temperature are not adopted and are kept with their reason under withheldSourceValues.
